correctness.rationale: PASS: Hand proof verified line-by-line. Lemma 1 (line meets unit circle at most twice) is standard quadratic argument and correct. Lemma 2 correctly classifies rich lines as exactly the 8 origin diameters: any 3-point line must contain origin plus two antipodal circle points, and no fourth point is possible. Lemma 3 correctly shows non-antipodal root pairs span ordinary lines and root-origin pairs lie on diameters. Pair accounting C(17,2)=136, 8*3=24 rich pairs, remainder 112 ordinary pairs each on a distinct ordinary line (two different pairs sharing a line would create a rich line) is exact. Independent replay of inputs/artifacts/verify_b17.py in exact Z[zeta16] arithmetic prints 120 lines, 8 rich diameters [k,k+8,16], 112 ordinary, 136/136 pairs covered, VERIFY_OK; float triple sweep confirms exactly 8 collinear triples. Degree-3 cell polynomial avoidance and counts disk:1, exterior x<1/2:11, x>1/2:5 also verified.

originality.rationale: PASS on strict prior-recording test for TARGET route (claim_route=TARGET, audited normally against admitted B17 >=9 claim). Fused live search over literal (16 roots plus origin 112 ordinary), equivalent (regular 16-gon with center Sylvester-Gallai Dirac-Motzkin n=17), and dominance (orchard/Green-Tao small-n census) directions found no source recording the B17 ledger. Green-Tao (arXiv:1208.4714) proves n/2 only for large n beyond a huge threshold; Csima-Sawyer 6n/13 gives only 7 at n=17 and does not imply 9 or 112; orchard tables cover small-n maxima plus asymptotics with no n=17 roots-plus-origin ledger. Hence the exact 112-line count is not previously recorded nor implied by the nearest substantive theorems. Trivial derivability from the generic circle lemma is a value defect, not prior recording, so originality passes under the shared standard.

value.rationale: FAIL: ADMISSION_DEFECT. The admitted triviality/value preflight (topic.audit_preflight triviality_preflight PASS, positive-resolution value case as first exact stability data point in 15-19 window with reusable polynomial-cell ledger) is materially false on the proved facts. The exact ledger 112 vs threshold 9 exceeds Dirac-Motzkin by 13x: B17 is highly non-extremal and teaches nothing about few-ordinary-line stability, which concerns sets with ~n/2 ordinary lines, not 112. The count follows in three lines from the textbook fact that a line meets a circle at most twice, i.e. a standard undergraduate exercise applied to n=16, generalizing immediately to C(n,2)-n/2 for any even n-gon plus center with no new idea. The degree-3 polynomial (x^2+y^2-1/4)(x-1/2) plays no logical role in forcing the quota; the hand proof never uses it. No future researcher needs this precise non-extremal count for orchard-planting (which maximizes 3-point lines; B17 has only 8) or Green-Tao casework. Under STANDARD, textbook restatements, mere parameter substitutions, and certification alone without benchmark significance fail value even if correct and new. No bounded addition can repair this intrinsic triviality without changing the problem, so REJECT not REPAIRABLE.
